observations: Photo 0 shows a pink plastic case open, revealing a keyboard with 36 keys (12 black, 24 white) and a flexible white hose attached to the top. The keys have colorful stickers (red, yellow, green, blue, purple, black) on them. The case has a handle and a small window.
Photo 1 shows the closed pink case with 'YAMAHA' embossed on the side. The case appears worn with scuffs and dirt. It is placed on a surface with cardboard boxes and other items in the background.

Photo 2 shows a white plastic case with 'YAMAHA' embossed on the side, placed on top of a keyboard with visible keys. The case has a textured surface and a vertical slot. The keyboard has keys with stickers (red, yellow, green, blue, purple, black) similar to photo 0.
All photos show a keyboard with 36 keys, consistent with a 36-key keyboard (e.g., a 36-key Yamaha keyboard).
The keyboard in photo 0 has a flexible hose attached, which is not typical for a standard keyboard and suggests it may be a wind instrument or a modified keyboard.
The keyboard in photo 2 has keys with stickers, which are not standard and may be decorative or for identification.
